highlights: Sings and plays guitar in his filmed live performances
Repertoire spans his own songs, folk songs and well-known covers
Filmed live in London churches, studios and Victoria Park
Latest single, 'Play The Fool', released in October 2026

faqs.q: Does he perform his own songs?
faqs.a: Yes. His live video of his single 'The Tide' credits him on guitar and vocals, with the lyrics written by Jamie Roche and Luke Carey.

faqs.q: Can we hear him before enquiring?
faqs.a: Yes. His YouTube channel has live performance videos, including his cover of Chris Isaak's 'Wicked Game', recorded at Sixty Sixty Sounds on Denmark Street in Soho.

serviceDetails.name: Folk and acoustic covers
serviceDetails.more: His channel also includes a cover of Gregory Alan Isakov's 'Amsterdam'.

notes: Kept deliberately short: he has no website, so there are no services, FAQ, booking or terms pages to draw on. Fetched on 27 Oct 2026: nine of his YouTube watch pages (titles and descriptions read directly) and his channel's public upload feed (channel UCZQax_Mikh4RczYcTdmhYMA), which confirms the same uploads. The channel's About page redirects to a consent screen, so it was not read. Nothing he publishes covers set lengths, line-up options, PA or power needs, notice periods, deposits, cancellation, travel, insurance or event types, so howItWorks and goodToKnow are empty. The 'Purple Rain' video is described as fan-made, so it is someone else's footage on his channel; the fan-filmed highlight and the service detail say so. The violin on 'The Green Fields of France' (Eilish Byrne-Whelehan) is not presented as a bookable line-up, because nothing says one is offered. A 2019 'Jamie Roche Live Stream' upload exists on the channel but was not opened. Coordinator removed the fan-filmed O2/celebrity reference.
